query: SELECT character.id AS "id!: i64", character.name AS "name!", agent_history.branch_id AS "branch_id!: i64" FROM character_group JOIN character ON character.id = character_group.character_id LEFT JOIN player_character ON player_character.character_id = character.id LEFT JOIN world_member ON world_member.id = player_character.member_id LEFT JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.character_id = character.id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.agent_id = COALESCE(player_character.agent_id, npc_agent.agent_id) WHERE character_group.group_id = ? AND (npc_agent.agent_id IS NOT NULL OR world_member.access = 'active') ORDER BY character.id
